title: workflow_execution
description: How workflow jobs run (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C10): which routes compile from the definitions a job pinned at accept, and the limits on what a job's result may hold.

compile_from_pin.description: Routes whose jobs compile from the definitions they pinned at accept, not from the live workflow file (docs/design/CODE_TO_DATA_S2.md, D2). Keyed by the route's capability, for example audio.generate. Only a literal true turns a route on.

legacy_output_collection.description: Whether a route that declares no output selector may still collect its outputs the old way (docs/design/CODE_TO_DATA_S2.md, D5). Only a literal false turns it off.

result_limits.description: Limits on a job's result (gateway/result_bundle.py, ResultLimits). A key left out keeps the code's ceiling.
